rationale: The agent correctly verified identity using full name and zip, located the right account and order, and provided valid exchange options based on product availability. The agent requested explicit confirmation before any order-changing action. When the user changed course, the agent did not proceed with the desk lamp exchange without confirmation and instead sought and received confirmation to return the water bottle. The return was processed via the appropriate tool for the correct item ID and order, with refund to the original PayPal method, and the final status reflects “return requested.” No policy violations or unsupported claims affecting the transaction were made.
